title: Zephyrine and the Songbook
author: Beatrix Joubert
blurb: Noor Yarrow, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
